## v0.3.1 — Global brightness, display light sleep

Patch release focused on battery efficiency.

**Apps:** Torch → Timer → Stopwatch → Settings

---

### Settings

- **Bright:** global backlight levels `32 / 64 / 128 (default) / 192 / 255`, stored in NVS (`bright_idx`)
- Applied on boot and when cycling in Settings
- **Torch** still uses its own brightness while open; leaving Torch restores the Settings Bright value

### Display sleep + light sleep

- After the configured Sleep timeout, backlight turns off (unchanged)
- If **no** Timer/Stopwatch is running, the shell enters **light sleep** (~200 ms cycles) and wakes on key press
- If a Timer or Stopwatch **is** running, light sleep is **disabled** so countdown/elapsed keep updating

### Idle loop throttle

- With the display on and no recent input / no running timers, the main loop slows from 5 ms to ~33 ms

### Other

- Default PlatformIO env remains standalone `m5stack-cardputer` (no M5Launcher required)

---

### Upgrade from v0.3.0

| Data | Notes |
|------|--------|
| Sleep option | Kept |
| Brightness | New; defaults to 128 |
| Timer / Stopwatch | Kept |

Install / flash the standalone `firmware.bin` (or `dist/` M5Launcher build if you still use the launcher).

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.3.1`

**Full diff:** https://github.com/bluedskim/cardputer_adv_firmware/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1
